read.title: A/B Test Results: Sun Cream Ads
read.text:
Here are the results of our two-week A/B test on Instagram ads for the Centella Sun Cream. We ran two variations with the same budget and audience.

Version A opened with a product close-up, while version B used a creator's face and a three-second hook: "No white cast, ever." Version B performed better, with a click-through rate of 2.1% versus 1.3%, and the difference was statistically significant.

We suggest moving 70% of the budget to version B and testing a new headline next week.

write.en: Ask your agency to run an A/B test with two versions of the cushion video ad before scaling up the holiday campaign.
write.model:
Hi Sarah,

Before we scale up the holiday campaign, let's run a quick A/B test. Could you make two variations of the cushion video: one with a product close-up and one with a creator's hook in the first three seconds? Please use the same budget for both.

Thanks,
Minsu
